facts.fact: The government told the National Assembly it has invested Sh4.6 billion in the Last Mile County Connectivity Project and that the Universal Service Fund provided Sh5 billion for the Digital Superhighway initiative.

KEN.note: No count of rural sites or people connected.
Cumulative spending with no budget year from 2024, no year-on-year figures and no statement on paying from own resources.

facts.fact: The Swala Nyeti article says the first two phases of the National Optic Fibre Backbone Infrastructure have rolled out about 13,000 km of fibre, which the ICT Authority oversees and is commercialising.
The government told the National Assembly that Sh11 billion went to the ongoing expansion of NOFBI II, after Sh4.3 billion for phase one and Sh7 billion for phase two.

KEN.note: ICT Authority oversees fibre projects; no government-run system or in-house build stated.
